name: zugel
description: Keeps AI coding agents inside your architecture: checks every new dependency against your .arc rules and stops dependency cycles from growing. Java, C# and Python.

server_version.description: latest (the default) always runs the newest version your license covers; 26.6.x stays on that line; 26.6.2 pins one exact version. The plugin needs 26.6.2 or newer
